data.description:
# Design experiment: validate session compaction gains without quality loss

Phase 2 of the compaction evaluation (previously LP-0MSG9PGOP009X2F2, since
deleted). Design a controlled experiment proving that compacting session
history (to fit under the routing clamp) and serving locally yields the
gains estimated in the log study (**now delivered as F1/F2 evidence:
LP-0MTC87GBV0031F4B distribution analysis and LP-0MTC8A2UB0040NKQ
correlation** — see `proxy/docs/context-compaction-eval/`) **without
degrading output quality**.

Times two-tier scheme (epic LP-0MTCW79RR000LFMJ): this experiment's outcome
**gates Tier 1 enforcement** (proxy-side proactive compaction,
LP-0MTCWE8NG003P0SD). Tier 2 (hard cap + cheap gate, LP-0MTBOX45O005LD1S)
is a routing-level safety net and does not depend on this experiment.

## User Story

As an operator, I want evidence that compacted-local responses are not worse
than uncompacted-remote responses on real tasks, so I can switch
over-clamp sessions to compact-and-serve-local with confidence.

## Experiment design requirements

- **Task suite**: representative real tasks drawn from logged sessions (or a
  synthetic suite mirroring them) — code editing, multi-file refactors, Q&A
  over long documents, agent tool-call loops. Must include tasks where long
  context matters (the risky population).
- **Conditions** (same tasks, three arms where feasible):
  - A: uncompacted → remote deepseek-v4-flash (current behaviour, baseline)
  - B: compacted → local Qwen3 (proposed)
  - C: uncompacted → local Qwen3 (ceiling, where the clamp allows;
    documents local capability at full context)
- **Compaction strategy**: **concrete — from the F3/F4 evaluation
  (LP-0MTC8B0BN009BMTJ / LP-0MTC8BWV50012WSW)**:
  - fast profile (Strategy B): auto-truncate to ≤ 38K when > 58.3K
  - cheap profile (Strategy C): summarize → truncate to ≤ 30K when > 43K
  Arm B uses the Tier 1 machinery (LP-0MTCWE8NG003P0SD) once implemented,
  or a manual equivalent in the interim.
- **Quality measurement**: task-completion rate, rubric-based output quality
  (or semantic-equivalence scoring vs. baseline), failure/truncation rate,
  retry rate. State the quality bar explicitly (e.g. compacted-local within
  X% of uncompacted-remote on the rubric, no increase in task failures).
- **Operational metrics**: latency (TTFT + total), local busy % change,
  remote request/token reduction, cost.
- **Go/no-go criteria**: pre-registered thresholds for quality (primary) and
  efficiency (secondary). State what would reject the approach.

## Deliverables

- Experiment design document (in a comment or repo doc referenced from this
  item) with task suite, arms, compaction strategy, metrics, sample sizes,
  and go/no-go thresholds
- List of new work items needed to implement the experiment harness, if any
- Recommendation: proceed to experiment execution (new work item) or abandon

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Design document covers arms, compaction strategy, quality metric +
      bar, operational metrics, go/no-go thresholds
- [ ] Reuses existing compaction/logging machinery (context_pressure path,
      Tier 1 warn-only dry-run); no speculative new infrastructure
- [ ] A follow-up work item for experiment execution is created if design is
      approved

## Sources

- F1 evidence: `proxy/docs/context-compaction-eval/distribution.md` (breach
  rates, per-mode distributions)
- F2 evidence: `proxy/docs/context-compaction-eval/correlation.md` (wasted
  prefill, decode collapse)
- Strategy choices: `docs/session-compaction-recommendations.md` (F4)

data.comment:
Design complete - all ACs satisfied (docs-only change).

- Design doc: docs/session-compaction-experiment-design.md (committed in this item's worktree)
  - Three arms A (uncompacted→remote deepseek-v4-flash baseline) / B (compacted→local Qwen3) / C (uncompacted→local ceiling where clamp allows), within-session blocking, blind rubric scoring
  - Task suite from F1/F2 logged sessions (code editing, multi-file refactors, long-doc Q&A, tool-call loops), stratified by mode + context band; risky population = sessions breaching triggers (fast >58.3K / cheap >43K)
  - Compaction strategy concrete from F3/F4: fast Strategy B auto-truncate→≤38K; cheap Strategy C summarize→≤30K with hard-cap backstop; extreme tail handled by Tier 2 gate (429, never silent remote/queue)
  - Quality bar pre-registered: B ≥ 0.95×A rubric (one-sided α=0.05), completion B ≥ A−3pp, no failure/gate increase; efficiency gate: ≥25% wasted-prefill reduction, TTFT P95 not >20% worse
  - Sample sizes (pilot 30–50/arm/mode + ≥10 extreme, power note), harness reuse (analyze_context_distribution/correlate, context_pressure hook, Tier 1 dry-run; no speculative infra), go/no-go rules, risks/caveats
- Follow-up execution item created: LP-0MTEH90U60023YWQ (parent: this item) — harness script + run + go/no-go report
- Recommendation: PROCEED to execution (F1/F2 waste evidence strong: 76.5% of prefill wasted, 99.1% in 15 sessions; quality is the only open question and is answered by the pre-registered measurement)
- AC1 ✓ (design covers arms/strategy/quality bar/operational metrics/go-no-go), AC2 ✓ (reuses context_pressure + eval scripts; manual prompt-assembly pass only as interim arm-B equivalent), AC3 ✓ (LP-0MTEH90U60023YWQ created)
- Full suite: no code changes; docs-only. Committing via implement.py finish.
